question: What power to curse and bless does reciting or remembering the armor confer?
premises: A mortal may recite or remember the armor
Such a person gains a special capability
The capability includes cursing and blessing
inference: A mortal who recites or remembers the armor becomes capable of cursing and blessing.
uncertainties: śāpānugrahaṇa taken as compound stem in context of capacity
plain_english: A mortal who recites or remembers it becomes capable of cursing and blessing.
